prompt.description: Optional natural-language request prompt describing the source Dynamo deployment and target GKE TPU environment.

dynamo_manifests.description: Fully expanded path to the file or directory containing NVIDIA Dynamo Kubernetes manifests (optional if source_namespace is provided).

source_namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace of a live NVIDIA Dynamo deployment to inspect and capture when dynamo_manifests is not provided.

source_context.description: Optional Kubernetes context for inspecting the source Dynamo deployment.

source_kubeconfig.description: Optional path to a kubeconfig file for inspecting the source Dynamo deployment.

run_id.description: Session run ID for artifacts isolation.

target_namespace.description: Kubernetes target namespace for the translated llm-d stack.

target_context.description: Optional Kubernetes context for the target GKE Cloud TPU cluster.

target_kubeconfig.description: Optional path to a kubeconfig file for the target GKE Cloud TPU cluster.

target_tpu_topology.description: TPU slice topology (e.g., 2x2x1 for 4 chips, 2x2x2 for 8 chips, 2x2x4 for 16 chips).

model_id.description: Optional Hugging Face model ID override if not specified or detected in the Dynamo manifests.

deployments_json.description: Optional path to a single-VM deployments.json file whose tuned serving flags and environment variables are carried over into the translated LeaderWorkerSet.

vllm_patch.description: Optional path to a custom vLLM patch file (.patch or .py) to mount and apply in the vllm-tpu container prior to launching vllm serve.

standalone_epp.description: Whether to generate a standalone EPP + Envoy proxy router Deployment.

envoy_configmap.description: Optional Envoy ConfigMap name for a standalone EPP router.

epp_service_account.description: Optional ServiceAccount name for the EPP router.

dry_run.description: Whether to validate manifests via Kubernetes dry-run apply.
